psf_cap_analysis.implied_psf_cap: For an in-band 3BR at the 1,000 sqft floor: S$2.0M = $2,000 psf, S$2.2M = $2,200 psf. For a typical ~1,100 sqft 3BR the ceiling is ~$2,000 psf; for a ~1,300 sqft 3BR (e.g. Palm Grove) the ceiling is ~$1,690 psf.

market_gaps.vs_cap: UNDER cap - room to spare (Palm Grove $1,540, The Quinn $1,940)
OVER cap - priced out unless via a low-floor hidden stack (One Amber floor ~$1,677)
AT cap - the band clears here (Carpmael, Grand Duchess, 8M)
under/at psf cap, but 3BR floor plates (1,259+ sqft) push total price just over the S$2.2M ceiling

filter_tradeoffs: TENURE is the single most binding filter in the Bartley/Woodleigh/MacPherson pocket, which is leasehold-dominated. Insisting on freehold there means near-zero supply; every qualifying D19 freehold/999 unit sits in Kovan/Hougang (The Quinn, Palm Grove, Tangerine Grove, Oasis Garden, Fiorenza), NOT Bartley/Woodleigh. If the buyer wants Bartley/Woodleigh specifically, they must relax tenure to 99-yr (which opens Kovan Regency's in-band 1,055 sqft 3BR immediately).
The >=1,000 sqft rule is what kills D14 Eunos: Urban Treasures (FH, 2023, Eunos) has in-band 3BR at ~S$1.95-2.0M but they are 883 sqft. Relaxing the size floor to ~880 sqft opens D14 immediately.

PSF-cap vs region trilemma: to hold an in-band >=1,000 sqft 3BR you are pushed OUT of prime D15 (Amber/Meyer) and INTO either (a) D19 Kovan/Hougang freehold (lower psf, further from town) or (b) the D15 East-Coast fringe (Katong/St Patrick's/Siglap). Freehold + large + central: pick two.

The 'hidden low-floor stack' in large freehold developments (One Amber 562u, Flamingo Valley 393u, Vacanza 473u) is the ONLY mechanism that gets a central/large freehold 3BR under the PSF cap - the band does not clear at project-average psf, only at the low-floor/unrenovated end of the range.
3BR emphasis (new this cycle) tightened the funnel vs the June 2BR/penthouse baseline: June's three matches were all 2BR/penthouse. Under the 3BR rule the clean pool shrinks to ~2-3 confirmed units.
